grid_conditions: DISCOM confirms transformer spare capacity of at least 93.3 kVA for the advised managed peak; connection feasibility remains unverified.

verdict.reason: Even the central case falls short of breakeven by 4.7 points. At this cost structure and price the site does not pay for itself.

site_facts.label: Road frontage

site_facts.label: Junctions within 500 m

site_facts.label: District EV registrations (2025)

site_facts.label: EV growth, year on year

site_facts.label: Dwell anchors
site_facts.means: Somewhere to go while charging is what makes a wait tolerable.

site_facts.label: Fleet operators within 10 km

site_facts.label: Distance to nearest city
site_facts.means: Distance to a city decides whether this is a destination or a passing stop.

site_facts.label: Amenities within walking distance

site_facts.label: Mobile network coverage
site_facts.means: A charger that cannot reach the network cannot take a payment.

site_facts.label: Night lighting

site_facts.label: Land or lease cost

site_facts.means: The closest alternative this site's drivers already have.

full-cost breakeven spreads the 15.00 lakh build cost over 10 years at 12%, which is 2.65 lakh a year - it is the steady-state volume at which NPV is zero, so it agrees with the NPV above rather than offering a second opinion
